target_moa.text: Piflufolastat F 18 is a urea-based ligand that binds to the active site of PSMA, which is overexpressed in prostate cancer cells, and dose-dependently inhibits PSMA enzymatic activity in vitro with a Ki of 1.1 nM; the F-18 label enables PET imaging.

citations.quote: Piflufolastat F 18 binds to the active site of prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA) which is overexpressed in prostate cancer cells and is also expressed in some normal organs. Piflufolastat dose-dependently inhibits PSMA enzymatic activity in vitro with a K_i of 1.1 \pm 0.1 nM.
Piflufolastat is a glutamate-urea-lysine (EuK)-based inhibitor that binds to and inhibits the N-acetyl-L-aspartyl-L-glutamate (NAAG) peptidase activity of PSMA.
